notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature.
Screams from Within attached to other creature.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing enchanted creature.
Screams from Within triggers, returning it from the graveyard to the battlefield attaching to Ajani's Chosen.
Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat token and attach Screams from Within to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer's ability, scrying one.
Repeat.
